note: What is Knos's own: GitHub account ids (the maintainer and the accounts its live tests run as) and wallets (a wallet has no GitHub id: Knos's own devnet keys, i.e. the rehearsal buyer, the CLI and deploy payers, the relay key, the wallets the maintainer bound, the passkey wallet of the run's own passkey round, the supplier and advancer wallets of its netting, advance and record rounds, the faucet key and the relay fee payers `scripts/load.py measure` derives from its wallet). A repository whose owner is one of these ids is Knos's without an entry here: GitHub is asked who owns it. scripts/network_stats.py never counts their activity as outside use.
